inputs.prompt: A concept artist sketchbook page of prop exploration for a dark fantasy video game: twelve rough concept sketches of the luggage of five alien exiles, a folded armoury of travel cases that pulse with glyph light, laid out in a grid of four columns and three rows on white paper, each sketch numbered with a big hand written number from 1 to 12. Loose confident pencil lines with grey marker shading and a quick wash of dark gunmetal, orange glyph light and rose gold. Every sketch shows the whole object in a three quarter view standing on bare sand, each a genuinely different idea, all made by one alien civilisation from pearly opalescent scaled shell, plum cloth printed with a starfield, rose gold trims and dark gunmetal with glowing orange glyph seams. Every one is a case or a set of cases, closed or opening. Not wooden crates, no shelves, no cloth. The twelve ideas: 1 stacked hexagonal cases that unfold like petals into weapon displays. 2 one tall case standing open like a wardrobe with tools held in light. 3 three cubes floating in orbit around each other. 4 a row of cylinder capsules lying side by side with pulsing seams. 5 a case shaped like a beetle shell that opens its wings. 6 nested cases inside each other like a set of boxes, opened out. 7 an upright monolith case with a seam down its middle. 8 a pair of pods fused onto a small hover sled. 9 a clamshell case of dark metal hinged on rose gold. 10 a long reliquary case with a domed lid. 11 slabs of dark metal leaning together like a fan, each a case. 12 a ring shaped case lying flat with a glowing core. Short hand written notes and arrows beside some sketches. Clean white paper, no frame, no other text.
